findings.title: Public S3 bucket: orca-demo-logs-archive
findings.description: Bucket 'orca-demo-logs-archive' grants AllUsers WRITE access and Public Access Block is not fully enabled.

findings.title: SSH open to internet: web-sg
findings.description: Security group 'web-sg' (sg-0a1b2c3d) allows inbound SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0. This port is commonly targeted by automated scanners within minutes of exposure.

findings.title: RDP open to internet: db-sg
findings.description: Security group 'db-sg' (sg-0e4f5g6h) allows inbound RDP (port 3389) from 0.0.0.0/0. This port is commonly targeted by automated scanners within minutes of exposure.

findings.title: Wildcard admin policy: FullAdminAccess-legacy
findings.description: Policy 'FullAdminAccess-legacy' attached to 'legacy-admin' grants Action:* on Resource:* — equivalent to full account admin access.

findings.title: Public S3 bucket: orca-demo-public-assets
findings.description: Bucket 'orca-demo-public-assets' grants AllUsers READ access and Public Access Block is not fully enabled.

findings.title: IAM user without MFA: svc-ci-deploy
findings.description: User 'svc-ci-deploy' has no MFA device registered. Access key age: 412 days.

findings.title: IAM user without MFA: legacy-admin
findings.description: User 'legacy-admin' has no MFA device registered. Access key age: 730 days.

findings.title: Port 443 open to internet: web-sg
findings.description: Security group 'web-sg' (sg-0a1b2c3d) allows inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Confirm this is intentional (e.g. a public web server on 443).

findings.title: Unencrypted EBS volume: vol-0abc111
findings.description: Volume 'vol-0abc111' (100 GiB), attached to i-0prod01, is not encrypted. Data at rest is not protected if the underlying storage is compromised.

findings.title: Unencrypted EBS volume: vol-0abc333
findings.description: Volume 'vol-0abc333' (20 GiB), attached to i-0staging01, is not encrypted. Data at rest is not protected if the underlying storage is compromised.
